description: The shared static asset CDN of Bun OS (UI design assets, fonts, AI and product brand assets), owned and operated by Infra. One source owns each file content; the CDN serves every source under one origin. Source paths are relative to this checkout. Built and published by scripts/aphrody/tools/infra/cdn.ts, served on the cdn.aphrody.com vhost of the vps host nginx (infra/config/host/nginx/aphrody/cdn.aphrody.com.conf).

cdn.note: `cdn.ts publish --vps vps` (or `--vps local` on the vps) rsyncs the release under releaseRoot/releases/<sha> and switches `current`. The release tree is published under /s/ and /h/ by aphrody-fonts-proxy (`--static releaseRoot/current`); the paths it does not hold fall through to the Google Fonts proxy.

sources.owns: Material 3 design system: fonts, Google design references, UI screenshots and art direction, Chrome web app captures. The scope keeps its historical name os so published /s/os/ URLs stay stable.
UI fonts and their OFL notices, published under the historical /s/os/fonts/ paths.
WOFF2 web subsets of the M3 fonts (packages/m3-fonts/src/fonts.css), referenced by hashed URL from aphrody-fonts.css; their OFL notices are the ones of /s/os/fonts/.

Aphrody logo set generated by aphrody-identity (export-assets): favicon.ico, PNG and maskable icons, apple-touch-icon, icon.svg, wordmarks, webmanifest, aphrody-logo.css, aphrody-fonts.css, M3 tokens.
Aphrody agent brand (Byron), product captures and renders.
Sovereign vector icons for Bun OS core pillars: Aphrody, Bun, COSMIC, Google, Android, Waydroid, and Gemini.
4K QHD vector wallpapers: Dark Obsidian, Tokyo Night, English Opal, Cosmic Dusk, and Celestial Gemini.
Authentic production screenshots of Bun OS, WebOS desktop, Craft Pro studios, Googlebook and system themes.

releases.name: material-symbols
releases.owns: Material Symbols Outlined, Rounded and Sharp (Apache-2.0, Google): variable fonts FILL 0..1, wght 100..700, GRAD -50..200, opsz 20..48; web WOFF2, desktop TTF and the Google-compatible material-symbols.css. Optimized 24 px SVGs and symbols/manifest.json stay in the repository.
releases.build: bun run build && bun run check && bun run cdn build && bun run cdn publish --host vps && bun run cdn verify

policy.singleOwner: A file content (sha256) lives in exactly one source; a copy in another source is a check error.
policy.licences: Fonts ship with their OFL.txt; third-party brand files stay reference material and are served noindex.
policy.exclusions: PSD sources stay in git, never on the CDN.
